summary: Iter146 — Backend regression on the 4 new RadioLife soft-launch enhancements (directory pagination, referral leaderboard + tier ladder, merchant setup checklist, launch teaser email). 25/25 pytest cases PASS end-to-end. GET /api/launch/businesses returns {total,items,loaded,has_more}: default limit=24, limit clamped 1..60 (limit=999 -> <=60, limit=0 -> >=1), offset windows the cached full list without overlap (limit=10 offset=0 vs offset=10 disjoint), and has_more is true mid-list and false past the end. GET /api/launch/leaderboard returns exactly the 5 tiers [Waitlisted/Insider/VIP/Founding Fan/Legend] with mins [0,1,3,5,10] and a top[] sorted desc by referrals with sequential ranks; every top entry has referrals>0 and its `name` is masked (contains bullet '\u2022' or ellipsis '\u2026' — no full email leaked). POST /api/waitlist and GET /api/waitlist/position both surface `tier`: fresh signup -> 'Waitlisted' (0 refs), and after crediting 1 referral the owner flips to 'Insider' (matches tier ladder). GET /api/merchant/soft-launch/checklist (auth) blocks anon (401/403), returns items in order [claim, profile, logo, catalog, cover(optional)] each with done + cta_route + cta_label, progress.total==4 (required only), and launch_ready == (all 4 required done); demo has_storefront=true and catalog_count is an int. GET /api/admin/launch/teaser-stats: anon and demo blocked (401/403); admin returns {total, teased, eligible_now} all ints. POST /api/admin/launch/teaser: anon/demo blocked; after seeding a fresh TEST_@example.com row eligible_now>=1, first admin send processed>=1, second send within 48h processed==0 (idempotent), eligible_now decreased and teased incremented. REGRESSION: /api/launch/status still exposes launch_at; POST /api/waitlist referral crediting still idempotent on re-submit (referrals unchanged); invalid email -> 400; missing code on /api/waitlist/position -> 400; merchant claim is idempotent (already:true); mode toggle ON (wait 11s) -> /api/shell/home 423 anon + 200 admin, mode toggled back OFF at the end. Mailgun is LIVE — only @example.com throwaways were used (TEST_iter146_*).
action_items: None — all 4 backend enhancements and the regression suite pass.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/launch/businesses caches the FULL list (~20s TTL) and paginates in-memory — good. Note: because the cache key is a module-level dict, pagination is consistent within a TTL window but a cache expiry mid-scroll could shift an offset boundary (mostly harmless with 24-row pages). Consider adding an ETag/`cached_at` to let the client detect a refresh.

leaderboard._mask_email masks the local part but preserves the domain's first char + '\u2026'. That's fine, but two entries with the same first-3 local chars and same first-domain-char become indistinguishable in the UI. Fine for a public leaderboard but flag if user identity matters.

_send_teaser writes teaser_sent_at AND $inc teaser_count in the same update — clean. However the 48h idempotency filter uses an ISO string comparison ($lt against ISO strings). This is correct only because Python's isoformat produces lexically-sortable timestamps in UTC; if launch_at were ever a non-UTC ISO stored alongside, the sort would break. It's safe today (_now_iso always UTC-aware).
The teaser query filters `launched_notified: {$ne: True}` — matches the launch-notify path exactly, so once we send the launch email we automatically stop teasing. Good.

Merchant checklist mutates DB (`launch_ready: true`) inside a GET handler. That's convenient but violates REST idempotency semantics — consider moving it to a POST or a scheduled job so cache/replay GETs don't cause writes.
